description:
The GPU BCJR product decoder and the gf2-algebra GPU path panic when HIP initialization or a HIP call fails recoverably. `@/inv/accelerator-safe-fallback` requires a tested safe fallback for recoverable accelerator failures.

## Background

`crates/gf2-coding/src/product/mod.rs` calls `.expect("Failed to initialize GPU BCJR")`; `gf2_algebra::gpu` panics on HIP failures. Found while writing the acceleration architecture page.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A recoverable HIP initialization or resource failure in the GPU BCJR product decoder selects the CPU path and returns the same decoded output as the CPU decoder, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-02: A recoverable HIP failure in `gf2_algebra::gpu` selects the CPU path or returns an error value; it does not panic, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-03: A fatal kernel or driver failure remains an explicit error.
title: GPU decoders panic on recoverable HIP failures
